# #579 -- SOURCE IDENTITY of the shipped census repair with the measured repair B (2026-11-04, the main loop)

Pass 2 on the F2R repair (grok, GLM, cloud Fable) named two wrong versions of repair B that no row on any medium can see (the
denominator set to the literal 35; the exclusion re-keyed onto another one-word session).  Fable: 'only source identity closes them'.
This file is that identity, computed by a script (no hand comparison):

* the measuring seat's base copy `_scratchpad/opus_census579/orig.py`: md5 dc191a6a0dc81cd0a47fc2853aa50703
* repair B regenerated by the seat's own `mkcopies.py <base> <out> repair` (exact-string edits, asserted unique): md5 d32537888454029630168273f803d3d0
* the repo probe as it will ship (`regress/ppc_llsc_probe.py`): md5 67d19cd8bf6ac496e020f107aedb002f
* their Python syntax trees, with the module docstring and every row() NOTE string blanked: IDENTICAL
* the census lines in the shipped probe:
      94: census_ok = census_all = 0
      142:     global symptom_hits, census_ok, census_all
      183:     census_all += 0 if name == "neg" else len(steps)    # the words PLACED, known before the run (neg runs no machine)
      190:                 census_ok += 1
      311: row("unasm census", "%d/%d" % (census_ok, census_all), "%d/%d" % (census_all, census_all),

So the shipped code is the code the seat measured -- identical syntax trees once the docstring and the row notes are blanked, and the census line is the seat's exact text -- (35/35 build, 0/35 on both null media); the docstring and the
three F19 notes are the only differences, and they are text no row reads.
